subject: is functionality already built outside ggplot2 to put a scale on the right side or on the top of a plot?

messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: is functionality already built outside ggplot2 to put a scale on the right side or on the top of a plot?
parts:
Hi all,

Judging from the thread below, the decision was made not to provide ggplot2 the functionality to put a scale on the top or on the right side of a plot:

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!searchin/ggplot2/put$20x$20scales$20on$20top/ggplot2/gRtNlJFKzPA/g9gdQbvCWSgJ

Just want to confirm this is the case, and if so, whether or not this functionality now exists in an add-on package, as the thread hints may be the best eventual option.

Thanks again for the help!


Adam Loveland

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: is functionality already built outside ggplot2 to put a scale on the right side or on the top of a plot?
parts:
It doesn't work now, but hopefully it'll be in the next release after
0.9.2, which is going to be sent to CRAN at the beginning of
September.
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/619

If it ends up being very complicated, we may push it off until the
next release after that. Deciding how they'll interact with facet
labels might be a challenge.

-Winston
